verificationTarget: Editor marks selected text-block descendants represented inside columns/table Preview surfaces as visible selected mini objects, while keeping the owning composite surface as context and preserving existing Backend/Core boundaries.
summary: Done: Editor commit 7730a543fb572680144ed8252d9a20d28ce44b7d adds bounded selected composite preview child visual state. PaperPage passes selectedNodeId into PaperBlock, and PaperBlock matches that id against editableTextDescendants represented in columns/table preview labels before setting data-canvas-text-descendant-selected on the exact preview child. The owning columns/table paper surface keeps its surface data-node-id and receives only a subtle descendant-selected context marker, so structural selection and mutation behavior remain surface-based. CSS gives selected child preview targets a stable teal background, border, inset highlight, and pointer cursor without resizing the preview item. The live local Backend browser smoke records selectedPreviewTextDescendantIds and reloadedSelectedPreviewTextDescendantIds as summary-left-text, plus computed visual style values for the selected child. This does not enable WYSIWYG behavior, contenteditable runtime, direct click-to-type authoring, exact table cell editing UI, exact column layout editing UI, arbitrary rich-inline authoring, field-ref editing, durable drafts, broad frontend readiness, Core truth, Backend truth, Editor truth, FlowDoc product truth, or map truth.
